get.description: Returns available reservation slots around the requested timestamp, excluding past slots. When exactly one project location is requested, results also include every remaining slot on the restaurant's local date of the requested timestamp. Slots with a "payment" object require a credit card on file before booking. Results may include adjacent dates and may be partial when availability cannot be retrieved for every requested venue. Results are grouped by project location, and locations without available slots are omitted.

delete.summary: Remove a hold on a reservation slot
delete.description: Removes a hold owned by the authenticated caller. Removing an already released or expired hold succeeds. A hold already used to book a reservation cannot be removed. Unknown holds and holds belonging to another caller return 404. Once removal starts, the hold cannot be used to book a reservation. If removal fails, retry it with a new idempotency key.

post.description: Creates a reservation from a hold. When state is EXTERNAL_BOOKING_REQUIRED, complete booking at external_url and supply the resulting external_id to updateReservation to confirm the same reservation.

201.description: Reservation created. The request succeeded; status and state describe the reservation's lifecycle independently of the HTTP response status.

get.description: Pending and confirmed reservations whose time has not passed come first, soonest first, followed by all other reservations, most recent first. Pending reservations in EXTERNAL_BOOKING_REQUIRED state are omitted.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

patch.description: Supply external_id to confirm a reservation in EXTERNAL_BOOKING_REQUIRED state after completing booking at its external_url. The booking is verified before the same reservation is confirmed. Supply a new hold_id to change the reservation to the held slot. The hold must belong to the caller and the same venue as the reservation. Its party size is used unless guests is supplied, in which case it must match. Without a hold, omitted fields remain unchanged. An expired or already used hold cannot be used again. payment_source_id may only be supplied with hold_id and is required when the held slot requires payment. Some changes create a replacement reservation. In that case the response has a new id and original_id identifies the previous reservation. The replacement is confirmed before the previous reservation is cancelled. Cancellation of the previous reservation may finish after the response; retrieve that reservation to check its current status.

external_id.description: Booking reference returned after completing booking at external_url for a reservation in EXTERNAL_BOOKING_REQUIRED state. Repeating verification of the same already associated booking is idempotent; changing the associated booking identity is not accepted.

hold_id.description: Identifier of the new reservation hold returned by createHold.

payment_source_id.description: Saved payment source selected for the held slot. Only accepted with hold_id and required when the held slot requires payment.

notes.description: User written notes for the reservation

delete.description: Cancels an established reservation. A pending reservation in EXTERNAL_BOOKING_REQUIRED state is deleted and returns no content.

ReservationPolicies.description: Restaurant policies for the reservation's date, time and party size.

booking.description: Restaurant booking policies, such as grace periods and table time limits, to show the guest. Empty when the restaurant has none or they are temporarily unavailable.

ReservationStatus.description: Broad reservation lifecycle category. Confirmed means an established booking, including one awaiting guest confirmation or currently in service. Completed means service has finished. Failed includes no-show and refused-entry outcomes. This value does not indicate whether an API request succeeded; inspect state for the specific lifecycle stage or outcome.

ReservationState.description: Specific reservation lifecycle stage or outcome. EXTERNAL_BOOKING_REQUIRED means booking must be completed at the reservation's external_url. PENDING is held or unreconciled; BOOKED is an established booking awaiting guest confirmation; CONTACTED and NO_ANSWER describe attempts to contact the guest; CONFIRMED means the guest has confirmed. ARRIVED includes partial arrival or seating. ORDER_PLACED includes meal courses. CHECK_DROPPED and CHECK_PAID describe the check. COMPLETE means service has finished. GUEST_CANCELLED and VENUE_CANCELLED identify cancellation attribution. NO_SHOW and NO_ENTRY describe unsuccessful attendance. An unrecognized lifecycle observation is classified as PENDING, BOOKED, or CONFIRMED from the available evidence.

ReservationPayment.description: Credit card or payment requirement. The total amount is zero when no deposit is required.

message.description: Policy text to show the guest, as plain text with paragraphs separated by line breaks.

language.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag of the message, such as en-US. Null when unknown.

cutoff_days_before.description: Number of days before the reservation date by which the guest must cancel to avoid being charged the reservation's payment.

charge.description: Amount charged to the guest's card for cancelling after the cutoff or not showing up. Null when the reservation's payment is a deposit, which is kept instead, or the amount is unknown.

amount.description: Amount in the currency’s minor units.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

ProblemType.description: A URI reference identifying the problem.
